title: Naseeb: The Jeep Driver
shortDescription: You are Naseeb, a jeep driver in the far north. Take your old jeep up a narrow mountain track, with real physics.
description: You are Naseeb, a jeep driver in the far north. Take your old army-green jeep up a narrow dirt track cut into a forested mountain: six legs and tight hairpins you may have to back up to get round, steep climbs, deep ruts, potholes, fallen logs and stones, with the mountain on one side and a drop on the other. The jeep is built up from its tires with real physics: a straight six, three gears in high and low range, part-time four-wheel drive, leaf springs, tires that climb edges and grip along slopes, and a chassis that scrapes. Snow peaks, drifting clouds, morning, afternoon or evening light, and engine and tire sounds made from the physics.
howToPlay: Hold the throttle to drive; the automatic picks the gear.
Press 1 to 6 to choose a gear yourself (1 is Low 1st, for the steepest bits), 0 to hand back to the automatic.
Hold the brake to stop; held at a standstill, it backs up.
Steer with the arrow keys or the on-screen buttons.
Some hairpins are too tight to get round in one go: stop, back up, and go again.
Off the road or rolled over? The Back on the road button puts you back where you left it.

touch.gesture: Tap a gear above the pedals
Drag the scene; pinch to zoom
